summary: Bright Way has strong doctors, real offers and a good location. The website does not turn that into booked appointments yet. These are the gaps I saw on your public site, and how I would close them.

findings.problem: Every Book an Appointment button opens a popup with a message form only: name, email, message. No date, no phone field.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book has to wait for a reply, and many will message the next clinic on Google Maps instead.
findings.fix: Booking form with preferred date and time, service and phone, sent to you instantly.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp button anywhere. Only two phone numbers are listed.
findings.cost: In Dubai most patients prefer WhatsApp. They will not call a number from a website.
findings.fix: One tap WhatsApp button on every page, with a pre-filled message per treatment.

findings.problem: Mission, Vision and Approach sections appear twice. Typos such as MakesBright Way and DentistrySmarter. LinkedIn and Our Services links go nowhere.
findings.cost: A clinic is judged by how careful it looks. Errors make new patients doubt the care they will get.
findings.fix: Clean, proofread pages and working links, with the structure rebuilt around treatments.

findings.problem: Only two testimonials, both for one doctor, and the smile gallery shows no before and after images.
findings.cost: Implant and cosmetic patients decide on proof. Thin proof means more price shopping.
findings.fix: Review wall pulled from your real Google reviews and a before and after gallery.

redesign: A fast, modern homepage that leads with your top treatments (implants, cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics) and the offer you want to push.
Online booking and WhatsApp on every page, so a patient can book in under 30 seconds on a phone.
A page per treatment and per doctor, written to rank for searches like dental implants Dubai.
Proof first layout: Google reviews, before and after cases and insurance logos near every booking button.
